picked.t: From employee to daughter-in-law: Vietnamese woman marries Korean boss's son
picked.body: After years of working directly under her strict Korean boss in Hai Phong, Pham Anh Tho trusted her so deeply that when the woman's son proposed after just three months of dating, she agreed to marry him. Tho, a graduate of Vietnam Maritime University, joined a technology equipment installation company in Hai Phong in 2021 as a safety officer and interpreter. There, she worked directly under Park Soo-jeong, 58, the Korean woman who ran the business. "At work, I was terrified of her because she was strict and disciplined, but outside the office, she was very warm and friendly," Tho recalls. Tho lived in Le Chan District, near the company dormitory. When Park noticed that she often worked late and missed the bus home, she would give her a ride in the company car. Knowing Tho loved kimchi, Park frequently invited her over whenever she cooked Korean food. She also took the young employee grocery shopping, to concerts and on food tours around Hai Phong. "I was fond of her, but I never imagined she would one day become my daughter-in-law," says Park, a Seoul native. In March 2021, Park's son Gil-sun moved to Vietnam to help with the family business. The 1.85-meter-tall Korean man soon noticed Tho, who stood just 1.5 meters tall. "My mother and sister are both tall, so I have always liked petite, cute women," the now 34-year-old says. Tho also noticed him, not least because he was the youngest and tallest among the Korean staff. Gil-sun began buying her snacks and inviting her to dinner, joking that he needed her to act as his tour guide in Hai Phong. Their friendship quickly developed into a romance. Park was pleased when she realized her son was interested in Tho, though she also worried about the challenges of a cross-cultural relationship. "You must be serious about her because she is a good girl," she told him, warning him to be thoughtful and avoid misunderstandings arising from cultural differences. Around two months later, Gil-sun had to return to South Korea. With the Covid-19 pandemic making it unclear when he could come back to Vietnam, he asked his mother to formally approach Tho's family on his behalf and ask for her hand in marriage as proof of his commitment. Tho initially hesitated. But her years of working with Park had given her confidence in the family. She believed that a disciplined woman like Park would have raised her son to be responsible and respectable. Tho's parents in Hai Phong were also skeptical at first. But after meeting Gil-sun and seeing his modesty and sincerity, they gave the couple their blessing. Their wedding was held simply during the pandemic. Park personally carried a ceremonial tray to Tho's home as part of the traditional marriage proposal. After the wedding, Tho moved to Seoul to live with her husband's family. There, however, she encountered a way of life very different from the one she had grown up with. Gil-sun's paternal family came from an old aristocratic lineage and placed strong emphasis on tradition and etiquette. Park herself had lived under similarly strict expectations when she was a young daughter-in-law. While her own mother-in-law was alive, she was expected to prepare three meals a day, make late-night snacks and keep the house immaculate regardless of how busy she was. Those habits stayed with her. She expected Tho to wake up early, prepare breakfast and other meals, maintain a tidy home and observe proper forms of respect when speaking to her and her husband. Tho, by contrast, had been pampered by her parents and grew up in a relatively carefree household. She enjoyed going out for coffee, walking around town and eating out with her husband. Adjusting to the rigid household routine in Seoul proved difficult. Small conflicts gradually emerged over meals, everyday habits and later parenting. When disagreements arose, Tho often asked her husband to explain her perspective to his mother, but Gil-sun's clumsy attempts at mediation sometimes made matters worse. "In the beginning, I felt trapped because I was not used to that kind of lifestyle," Tho says. Her sister-in-law eventually became an important ally. As a daughter-in-law herself, she helped Park understand how difficult the transition was for Tho. Over time, Park began to relax her expectations. "I realized it was not that Tho was unwilling to be a good daughter-in-law. I was simply being too strict," she says. "Because I had spent so many years living that way myself, I assumed everyone should do the same." Tho also made an effort to bridge the gap. Instead of avoiding difficult conversations, she began speaking openly with Park. Knowing her mother-in-law enjoyed Vietnamese food, particularly bun dau mam tom—rice vermicelli served with fried tofu and shrimp paste—and northern Vietnamese dishes, she cooked them for her. picked.t: IBK기업은행, 9년 공들인 베트남 현지법인 공식 영업 돌입 '중소기업 밀착 지원'
picked.body: 지난 13일 베트남 하노이에서 개최된 'IBK베트남은행 출범식'에서 (왼쪽 여섯 번째부터) 이미연 주베트남 대한민국 대사, 팜꽝중 베트남 중앙은행 부총재, 장민영 IBK기업은행장, 김기문 중소기업중앙회 회장, 고태연 주베트남한국상공인연합회 회장, (맨 오른쪽) 박경일 IBK베트남은행 법인장 등이 기념촬영을 하고 있는 모습 (사진=기업은행) 'IBK베트남은행'이 엄격한 외국계 은행 규제로 유명한 베트남 금융시장의 높은 문턱을 넘어서 첫발을 내딛었다. IBK기업은행은 지난 13일 베트남 수도 하노이에서 현지 법인인 'IBK베트남은행'의 정식 출범 행사를 개최했다고 14일 밝혔다.  IBK기업은행은 지난 4월 베트남 중앙은행(SBV)으로부터 최종 본인가를 획득한 지 수개월 만에 모든 행정·실무 절차를 완료하고, 9월 25일부터 본격적인 영업 활동에 돌입한 상태다. 이번 법인 설립은 베트남 당국의 은행권 구조조정과 외국계 금융사 인가 동결 기조 속에서 달성한 성과다. 기업은행은 장장 9년에 걸쳐 현지 금융당국을 설득한 끝에 베트남 내 10번째 외국계 법인은행 타이틀을 거머쥐었다. 새롭게 닻을 올린 IBK베트남은행은 기존 하노이와 호치민 거점 지점의 운영 실적에 더해, 지난 60여 년간 국내에서 입증된 중소기업 전용 정책금융 시스템을 이식한다.  특히 한국 기업들이 대거 입주한 주요 산업단지를 중심으로 거점 점포를 점진적으로 늘려나갈 계획이다. 이를 통해 현지에 진출한 한국 기업은 물론 현지 중소기업에도 자금을 활발히 공급하는 생산적 금융을 구현하고, 양국의 경제적 연대를 공고히 한다는 전략이다. 박경일 IBK기업은행 초대 법인장은 2008년 호치민 지점으로 시작된 베트남 영토 확장이 이번 법인화로 완성된 현지화의 이정표가 되었다고 평가했다. 이어 비가 올 때 우산을 씌워주는 상생 금융 역량을 바탕으로, 베트남 경제와 궤를 같이하며 성장하는 든든한 파트너 은행으로 뿌리내리겠다는 비전을 밝혔다.

picked.t: Vietnam waives visas for Chinese tour groups to Nha Trang
picked.body: The visa-exemption policy took effect from Oct. 12 as part of the Vietnam-China Tourism Cooperation Year 2026–2027 and will remain in place until Dec. 31, 2027. The exemption applies to Chinese citizens holding valid ordinary passports who join all-inclusive tour packages organized by Vietnamese international travel agencies. Groups must consist of at least two travelers, and tours cannot exceed 30 days. They are only allowed to travel within Khanh Hoa. Under the scheme, eligible visitors must fly directly from mainland China to Cam Ranh International Airport, about 40 kilometers from downtown Nha Trang, and exit Vietnam through the same airport. The exemption does not apply to independent travelers, tourists without an eligible all-inclusive tour package, or those entering or departing Vietnam through other border checkpoints. Holders of passports issued by China's Hong Kong and Macau special administrative regions are excluded from the policy. Vietnam's Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism and the Ministry of Public Security have been assigned to issue guidance on implementation procedures and entry requirements. Khanh Hoa used to be a favorite destination for Chinese tourists before Covid. In 2019, the province welcomed more than 2.5 million Chinese visitors, accounting for 75% of international visitors. According to the Khanh Hoa's Department of Culture, Sports and Tourism, the province received about 378,600 Chinese visitors in the first seven months this year, down more than 5.3%, making them the third largest foreign tourist source, behind South Korea and Russia. Nationwide, China remained Vietnam's largest source market for inbound tourism in the first nine months of the year, with 3.95 million arrivals, up 1.5% year-on-year.

picked.t: 베트남, ‘냐짱’ 방문 중국 단체관광객 내년까지 30일간 비자면제
picked.body: 베트남 칸화성 냐짱 일대. (사진=냐짱동 인민위원회) 베트남이 중국인 단체 관광객을 대상으로 중부 해안 관광지인 칸화성(Khanh Hoa)에 한해 무사증(무비자) 제도 시범 운영에 들어갔다. 이에 따라 베트남 여행사의 패키지 상품을 통해 중국 본토에서 입국하는 2인 이상 단체 관광객은 칸화성을 비자 없이 여행할 수 있다. 칸화성은 유명 해안 관광지인 냐짱(Nha Trang)의 소재지다. 베트남 정부에 따르면, 이번 무비자 정책은 '베트남-중국 관광협력의 해 2026~2027'의 일환으로 지난 12일부터 시행됐다. 베트남 국제 여행사가 기획한 올인클루시브(항공·숙박·식사) 패키지 투어에 참가하는 일반 여권을 가진 중국인이 대상으로, 2027년 12월 31일까지 적용된다. 구체적으로, 그룹 여행객은 최소 2명 이상으로 구성되며, 여행 기간은 30일을 초과할 수 없다. 여행 범위는 칸화성 내로 제한된다. 무비자 혜택을 제공받는 단체 관광객은 중국 본토에서 직항편을 통해 입국해야 하며, 출입국은 모두 냐짱 시내로부터 약 40km 떨어진 깜란(Cam Ranh)국제공항을 통해 이뤄진다. 이 외 개별 여행객이나 요건에 맞는 올인클루시브 패키지 상품을 이용하지 않는 관광객, 깜란공항 외 다른 국경검문소·공항을 통해 입국하는 중국인 여행객은 무비자 혜택이 적용되지 않는다. 또한 중국 홍콩·마카오 특별행정구가 발급한 여권 소지자도 이번 정책 수혜 대상에서 제외된다. 해당 정책의 시행 절차와 입국 요건에 관한 지침은 베트남 문화체육관광부와 공안부 소관이다. 칸화성은 코로나19 팬데믹 이전 많은 중국 관광객이 방문하던 주요 관광지로, 지난 2019년에는 중국인 방문객 250만 명 이상이 이곳을 찾아 전체 외국인 방문객의 75%를 차지했다. 칸화성 문화체육관광국에 따르면, 7월 기준 칸화성을 찾은 중국 관광객은 약 37만8,600명으로 전년 동기 대비 5.3% 감소했다. 현재 중국은 한국과 러시아에 이어 3번째 칸화성 인바운드 관광 시장이다. 한편, 올 들어 9월까지 베트남을 찾은 외국인 관광객 가운데 중국인은 395만 명으로 전년 동기 대비 1.5% 늘어 최대 인바운드 관광국 지위를 유지했다.

picked.t: 베트남, ‘오토바이’ 생산 큰 폭 증가 속 전기이륜차 비중 확대…9월 기준 300만 대 돌파
picked.body: 호치민시의 한 거리에서 퇴근길 오토바이들이 신호 대기 중인 모습.  올 들어 베트남의 오토바이 생산량이 9월 기준 300만 대를 돌파하면서 큰 폭의 증가세를 보이고 있다. 그러나 시장이 포화 단계에 들어서면서 베트남 이륜차 제조사들은 전기이륜차 등 고부가가치 모델로 전환 압박을 받고 있다. 베트남 재무부 통계국(NSO) 자료에 따르면, 9월 한 달간 베트남 국내 오토바이 생산 대수는 35만3,000대에 달한 것으로 잠정 집계됐다. 이는 전월 대비 13%, 전년 동기 대비 38% 급증한 것이다. 이에 따라 9월 기준 누적 생산 대수는 313만여 대로 전년 동기 대비 28% 증가했다. 이로써 올 한 해 연간 생산량은 작년(340만 대) 수준을 넘어설 것이 확실시 되고 있다. 올 들어 베트남의 오토바이 생산 대수는 지난 2월 뗏(Tet 설) 영향으로 22만4,700대로 감소했다 3월 36만6,100대로 곧바로 회복한 뒤, 4월 38만1,800대로 정점을 찍었다. 이후 5~6월 36만6,000여 대 안팎을 유지하다 8월 31만3,400대로 다소 감소하는 모습을 보였다. 업계 관계자들은 “9월 생산량 반등은 통상 오토바이 수요가 늘어나는 연말 쇼핑 시즌을 앞두고 제조사들이 대리점 재고를 선제적으로 확충하려한 결과”라며 “주요 도시의 오토바이 보유율은 이미 높은 수준으로, 생산 증가가 곧바로 신규 구매의 증가로 이어지는 것은 아니”라고 지적했다. 한편, 베트남 오토바이 시장은 전기이륜차 비중 확대로 경쟁 구도가 빠르게 변화하고 있다. 앞서 베트남 오토바이 시장은 혼다와 야마하, 피아지오(Piaggio), 스즈키, SYM 등 베트남오토바이제조협회(VAMM) 회원사들이 다양한 라인업을 앞세워 시장을 장악하고 있었으나, 베트남의 국가적인 친환경 모빌리티 전환 기조 아래 최근 수년간 빈패스트(VinFast), 셀렉스모터스(Selex Motors), 야디(Yadea), 페가(Pega), 닷바이크(Dat Bike) 등 국내외 전기이륜차 업체들이 새로운 모델과 유통망, 충전 인프라, 배터리 교환 시스템으로 영향력을 확대해가고 있다. 특히 전기이륜차와 기존 내연기관 이륜차 간 가격·성능 격차가 좁혀지면서 내연기관 중심의 오토바이를 만들던 기존 제조사들도 전동화 전략을 서둘러야 하는 상황이다. 업계에 따르면, 향후 오토바이 제조사들은 △ABS 및 스마트폰 연동 프리미엄 모델 △도심 물류 및 라스트마일 배송용 특수차량 △배출가스 규제로부터 자유로운 전기이륜차 등 3가지 분야에 집중할 것으로 예상된다. 인도 자동차 산업 전문 데이터 솔루션 업체 마크스탯(Marqstats)에 따르면 베트남 오토바이 시장 규모는 지난해 38억9,000만 달러에서 2030년 46억4,000만 달러로 성장하고, 판매량은 312만 대에서 385만 대로 늘 것으로 예상된다. 마크스탯은 2030년 내연기관 이륜차 판매량은 170만 대로 연평균 8.25% 감소할 것으로 예상한 반면, 전기이륜차 판매량은 215만 대로 시장의 55.84%를 차지할 것으로 내다봤다. 연평균 성장률은 33.8%로, 이러한 전망이 현실화한다면, 베트남은 역내에서 전기이륜차가 내연기관 오토바이보다 많이 팔리는 최초의 국가가 될 전망이다.

picked.t: Ho Chi Minh City to eliminate 28 traffic bottlenecks by 2030
picked.body: Department director Tran Quang Lam outlined the goal during the "Citizens Ask – Government Answers" program on Oct. 11. He emphasized that resolving these hotspots remains a top municipal priority through 2030. Priority will be given to completing ongoing and planned projects to ease congestion at key locations. These include the My Thuy and An Phu interchanges, National Highway 13, the Nguyen Khoai bridge-and-road project, and Binh Tien. Lam noted that addressing the 28 bottlenecks is just one component of a broader infrastructure strategy. The city also aims to complete its wider transport network, improve regional connectivity, and develop new economic corridors. Surveys conducted prior to the city's administrative merger with Binh Duong and Ba Ria-Vung Tau provinces last year identified several persistent bottlenecks. These included the Hang Xanh intersection, Nguyen Tat Thanh Street, and the An Phu and My Thuy interchanges. Similar congestion issues plague intersections and industrial parks in the former Binh Duong and Ba Ria-Vung Tau areas. Beyond existing projects, authorities are studying plans to construct steel overpasses at various locations to further alleviate traffic. Transport hub Ho Chi Minh City serves as a major national and regional transportation hub, integrating aviation, maritime shipping, inland waterways, and railway networks. The megacity currently handles approximately 37% of Vietnam's air passenger traffic and 65% of its container cargo volume. However, widespread infrastructure bottlenecks and poorly integrated transport networks remain significant challenges. Localized congestion continues to hamper residents' daily lives, economic development, and the overall investment climate. Following the recent administrative merger, the city identified three primary focus areas for transport development. The immediate priority is eliminating existing bottlenecks. The second goal is completing backbone infrastructure and strengthening regional connectivity via ring roads, expressways, and national highways. The third priority involves expanding the metro network in alignment with the Transit-Oriented Development model. The city expects to largely complete its backbone transport infrastructure by 2030. However, the department warned that these initiatives alone will not sustain a megacity of 14 million residents, which is projected to reach 25 million in the future. Officials have identified the expansion of the urban railway network as the fundamental long-term solution. The metro network is expected to expand to 255 km by 2030, and to roughly 500 km over the subsequent decade. Under the revised master plan, the network will ultimately reach 1,500 km in total length. "These are not merely targets the city has set; preparations have already been made to ensure that implementation is feasible," Lam said. He noted that metro projects now benefit from special administrative mechanisms that grant the city greater autonomy. New urban development policies are also helping authorities mobilize resources, diversify investments, and accelerate implementation. Department of Finance deputy director Truong Tan Vu confirmed that transportation infrastructure remains a top investment priority. Projects are being categorized to ensure the efficient use of resources. Funding will focus on initiatives that address congestion, mitigate flooding, and boost economic development. The city has allocated approximately VND500 trillion (US$19.29 billion) for investment programs during the 2026-2030 period. This includes VND200 trillion earmarked for 98 transport projects, which covers the initiatives targeting the 28 congestion hotspots. Another VND120 trillion is allocated for 37 regional connectivity projects. An additional VND50 trillion is designated for 59 projects addressing severe flooding. The city will also continue relocating homes situated along canals and waterways. These efforts will be combined with urban renovation and transport infrastructure improvements to enhance the overall living environment.

picked.t: Hanoi adds greenery to transport infrastructure to reduce urban heat
picked.body: The Hanoi Department of Construction has directed local agencies to design and pilot greening projects across key transport infrastructure. The initiative will target three urban railway pillars along Nguyen Trai Street, the Le Van Luong-To Huu underpass, the Le Van Luong-Lang Ha overpass, and various downtown bus shelters. Greenery has already been successfully integrated into several of the city's existing transport facilities. Along Thang Long Boulevard, thousands of date palms currently line both sides of the underpasses and the central median. These palms serve as the primary canopy for the area, sheltering a diverse layer of smaller plant species cultivated beneath them. The 600-meter Trung Hoa underpass, featuring three traffic lanes across each of its 12-meter-wide sides, is now lined with climbing plants cascading down its concrete walls. Above the facility, various trees and flowers are planted in tiered layers, including Wrightia religiosa, crinum lilies, Arabian jasmine, hibiscus, canna lilies, and crepe myrtles. The route is primarily planted with Vernonia elliptica, a fast-growing climber known for its soft, naturally cascading branches. As the plants mature, they create lush green curtains that provide shade, filter dust, and cool the surrounding environment. The cascading foliage can extend 4–5 m downward. Watering schedules are adjusted according to weather conditions and the season. In summer and autumn, plants are typically watered at night or in the early morning. Clusters of slender-stemmed bamboo currently line the base of the overpass at the Le Van Luong-Lang Ha intersection. Authorities are now planning a pilot project to cover the bridge's supporting walls with climbing plants. The greenery will span approximately 200 sq.m, strategically divided into sections to complement the structure's existing architecture. At the intersection of National Highways 5 and 1, rows of small-leaved tropical almond trees—also known as Taiwan almonds—line the median and both sides of the approach roads. Spaced approximately three meters apart, the trees form a continuous green corridor. Vehicles traveling from National Highway 5 toward Bac Ninh pass beneath the shade of trees along the route as they approach Hanoi's eastern gateway. On the afternoon of Oct. 9, workers planted several species, including Monstera deliciosa, silver pothos, spider plants, and lantana, in pots attached to steel frames around the pillars of the Cat Linh-Ha Dong urban railway. Under the plan, the plants will climb the frames to cover the pillars in greenery without attaching directly to the concrete. This approach is designed to improve the urban landscape and reduce concrete surface temperatures. picked.t: UOB, 베트남 경제성장률 전망치 8.5→9.2% 상향 조정
picked.body: 베트남 호치민시 깟라이항.  싱가포르 3대 은행 중 하나인 유나이티드오버시즈은행(United Overseas Bank, 이하 UOB)이 올해 베트남의 경제성장률 전망치를 기존 8.5%에서 9.2%로 대폭 상향 조정했다. 3분기 예상치를 웃돈 국내총생산(GDP) 성장률과 제조업·서비스업을 중심으로 한 성장세를 반영한 조치다. UOB는 지난 13일 내놓은 최신 보고서를 통해 올해 베트남의 경제성장률 전망치를 9.2%로 상향 조정했다. 지난 7월 전망치를 7%에서 8.5%로 상향 조정한 데 이어 또다시 큰 폭으로 수정한 전망치를 내놓은 것이다. UOB는 전망치 상향이 올 들어 예상치를 웃돌고 있는 베트남의 경제성장률을 반영한 것이라 밝혔다. 실제로 3분기 베트남의 경제성장률은 전년 동기 대비 9.95% 증가해 2022년 3분기 이후 분기 최고치를 기록했으며, 9월 기준 누적 성장률도 9.01%에 달하고 있다. 이러한 성장은 주로 공업·건설업(+12.5%)과 서비스업(+9.54%)에 기인했다. UOB의 새로운 전망치에는 4분기 경제성장률이 약 9.7%에 이를 것이란 전망이 포함됐다. 올해 남은 기간 △공공투자 집행 확대 △수출 성수기 △사상 최고 수준의 외국인직접투자(FDI) 유입이 뒷받침한다는 설명이다. 그러나 4분기 성장 속도가 3분기보다 둔화할 가능성도 배제할 수는 없는 상황이다. 작년 4분기 성장률이 8.46%로 이미 높았던 데다 수출 주문이 줄어드는 조짐도 나타나고 있기 때문이다. 3분기 국내총생산(GDP)이 전년 동기 대비 9.95% 늘어 2022년 3분기 이후 가장 높았고, 1~9월 누적 성장률도 9.01%에 달했기 때문이다. 다만 제조업과 서비스업의 핵심 성장 동력은 회복세를 이어가고 있지만, 물가와 환율, 시스템 유동성에서 오는 압력은 면밀히 지켜봐야 할 거시경제 위험으로 꼽았다. 앞서 베트남 당정이 설정한 두 자릿수 성장 목표를 달성하기 위해서는 4분기 경제성장률이 12.5~13%에 달해야 한다. UOB는 이를 달성하기 어려운 수준으로 평가하면서도, 전반적으로 올해 성장률이 지난해(8%) 성장률을 크게 웃돌 가능성이 높다고 전망했다. UOB는 내년 베트남 경제성장률 전망도 기존 8.4%에서 8.8%로 올렸다. FDI 집행액이 증가하며, 자본이 실제 생산으로 이어지고 있다는 점과 지난 7월 28일 발표된 결의안 제19-NQ/TW호의 효과를 배경으로 들었다. SSI 리서치의 전략 보고서도 내년 경제성장률을 9~9.5%로 내다봤다. UOB는 베트남 경제를 긍정적으로 전망하면서도, 물가와 환율, 시스템 유동성에서 오는 압력은 면밀히 지켜봐야 할 거시경제 위험으로 꼽았다.

picked.t: Vietnam carriers gear up for tourism boom with new Asia, Europe services
picked.body: Vietnam's newest carrier Sun PhuQuoc Airways plans to launch its first international route between Phu Quoc and Moscow on Nov. 13 with an Airbus A330 aircraft as Russia is now one of Vietnam's fastest-growing tourism markets. Before that, on Oct. 15, it will launch a new service between Ho Chi Minh City and China's Shanghai megacity. Vietjet Air has also announced plans to expand its international network with flights linking Ho Chi Minh City with Male, the capital of the Maldives, with passengers transiting in Colombo. The service is scheduled to begin on Dec. 5. It will also launch new services between Hanoi and Prague, Czechia, and Almaty, Kazakhstan, this month. Vietravel Airlines said it will start flying between Hanoi and Shenzhen, known as the Silicon Valley of China, on Nov. 26. The expansion into Asia and Europe come as Vietnam received 17.7 million international visitors in the first nine months of 2026, up 14.5% year-on-year, bucking a declining trend seen in several Southeast Asian destinations like Singapore, Cambodia, and Thailand. Mainland China was Vietnam's largest inbound market, with 3.95 million visitors or 22.3% of all arrivals. Russia was third with 1.1 million visitors, up over 160% year-on-year. The number of Russian visitors is forecast to reach a record 1.5 million this year. European arrivals increased by more than 50%, while arrivals from markets like the United States, Australia, and India also recorded strong growth. This has helped Vietnam shrug off its earlier dependence on just one or two major Asian inbound markets. Industry insiders have urged the government to extend visa exemptions to nationals of major markets such as China and India and boost air connectivity with global tourism hubs to help the country reach its target of 25 million international visitors this year.

picked.t: Victims of Apax Leaders English school boss's $327M fraud rise to 10,123
picked.body: The Supreme People's Procuracy indicted Thuy, who led Egroup Education Group JSC as chairman and CEO, on charges of fraud to appropriate property and giving bribes. The procuracy first indicted him in December 2025, then sent the case back to Ministry of Public Security investigators, who began a supplementary investigation on July 27. In the same case, Tong Thi Kim Lien, chairwoman and finance director of Nhat Tran Company, is accused of receiving bribes. The indictment alleges she had her staff draw up 12 contracts and issue invoices that created VND2.327 trillion in fake revenue for Egroup, in exchange for money from Thuy. 27 others, including accountants and sales managers at Egame Investment and Distribution JSC, which Thuy also chaired, were indicted for fraud. The case will be tried by the Hanoi People's Court. Compared with the first indictment, the amount Thuy is accused of appropriating has grown from VND7.677 trillion to more than VND8.459 trillion. The alleged bribe is unchanged at nearly VND32 billion. According to the indictment, Thuy began directing staff in 2014 to inflate Egroup's charter capital so he could repay debts, fund personal spending and keep the Egroup ecosystem running. He then had fictitious shares transferred to investors. On his instructions, finance director Nguyen Manh Phu and chief accountant Pham Thi Thanh Tho inflated Egroup's charter capital from VND32 billion to VND962.5 billion. They also booked fake revenue equal to about 70% of annual revenue to make Egroup look like a large company. Once investors were drawn in, Thuy would sell them shares at VND38,000 each and pledge to buy them back a year later at VND42,000, in return for the investors authorizing him to exercise all their rights and obligations as shareholders. From 2021 to 2023, however, the group's Apax Leaders English centers and its kindergartens closed, and incoming cash could no longer cover expenses and maturing contracts. Thuy then let 23 managers and team leaders, who oversaw 341 sales staff, use 70% of the money raised from new clients to repay earlier clients still owed money, with the remaining 30% going to the company. From 2015 to 2023, Thuy and his accomplices appropriated VND8.459 trillion from 10,123 victims, the indictment alleges. Between August 2023 and January 2024, the Hanoi People's Court and 12 lower courts in the city issued 22 civil judgments that took legal effect, 18 of them involving 21 victims. The courts also issued two decisions recognizing settlements between parties and six decisions suspending civil cases involving Egame. At the request of the Ministry of Public Security, the Hanoi People's Court annulled all 18 judgments and the two settlement decisions. Victims' properties put in wife's name, then mortgaged Supplementary investigation documents show seven victims agreed, at Egame's request, to sign contracts transferring their properties to people the company designated. Six of them received strategic cooperation agreements for Egroup shares from Egame in return. Another victim transferred two properties and received bonds of Igarten Transaction Development JSC in exchange. Authorities also established that from August 2016 to June 2021, five notaries certified the transfer of, or powers of attorney over, 28 properties belonging to 29 victims to three companies and seven individuals. They found that the properties' legal status was checked during notarization and that the parties presented documents and followed procedures. The signatories had full legal capacity, signed voluntarily and showed no sign of being deceived or coerced. As the five notaries did not profit from the transactions, they will not face criminal proceedings. Also on Thuy's instructions, nine people signed contracts taking ownership of 32 properties and mortgaging them at banks. Among them, Thuy's wife, Le Thi Thanh Hien, and Egroup deputy CEO Nguyen Ngoc Khanh took ownership of six properties belonging to nine victims and later mortgaged them at banks. Investigators found that Hien and Khanh did not know about, and were not involved in, Thuy's sale of fictitious shares to investors. As they and the others who took ownership of victims' properties did not profit, police did not pursue criminal liability against them.
